name: TAKAHIRO YASUDA
introduction: Born in 1985, a Nagoya native Takahiro Yasuda started working for Draft Inc. from 2010 after he graduated from an art college. At the company, he built diverse expertise including art direction, product design, as a leader on its digital team NOROSI Project, movie direction, and other positions. Along with that, as a freelancer, he did graphic design, movies, vjing at various large-scale music festivals, and, in the end, he left it in June 2015. After that, he joined Cekai and took office as its Tokyo Office Representative in July 2016. Not only being an art/graphic director, but also launching solo exhibitions of his own works since 2015, he is ever evolving his practices multiply around visual expression.
